systemPrompt: Compare BEFORE and AFTER satellite images of Kuala Lumpur for visible changes. Locate newly expanded muddy floodwater and visible structural damage in AFTER. Compare the extent of water between both images; new water spread into adjoining land is a suspected flood even when individual structures cannot be resolved. Inspect the whole image, including upstream and downstream. Enclose the full visible changed area with tight boxes; use separate boxes for disconnected affected areas. Exclude unchanged river water, clouds, and shadows. If the images are identical, return hazards=[]. If visibility is insufficient, explain the limitation in summary. Use the full AFTER image coordinates: origin (0,0) top-left, (1,1) bottom-right. Return min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y as decimal ratios from 0 to 1, not pixels or latitude/longitude. Require min_x < max_x and min_y < max_y. Describe transit impacts as suspected and requiring field verification. Do not guess named bridges or confirmed road closures. Set water_depth_est_m=null without depth evidence. Return only JSON matching this schema: {"$defs": {"DetectedHazard": {"properties": {"title": {"description": "Name or short descriptor of the hazard", "title": "Title", "type": "string"}, "hazard_type": {"description": "E.g., RIVER_OVERTOPPING, BRIDGE_WASHOUT, LANDSLIDE, STRUCTURAL_COLLAPSE", "title": "Hazard Type", "type": "string"}, "severity": {"enum": ["CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MODERATE"], "title": "Severity", "type": "string"}, "water_depth_est_m": {"anyOf": [{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "Depth in meters only if supported by evidence, otherwise null", "title": "Water Depth Est M"}, "impact_description": {"description": "Impact on transit and evacuation corridors", "title": "Impact Description", "type": "string"}, "min_x": {"maximum": 1.0, "minimum": 0.0, "title": "Min X", "type": "number"}, "min_y": {"maximum": 1.0, "minimum": 0.0, "title": "Min Y", "type": "number"}, "max_x": {"maximum": 1.0, "minimum": 0.0, "title": "Max X", "type": "number"}, "max_y": {"maximum": 1.0, "minimum": 0.0, "title": "Max Y", "type": "number"}}, "required": ["title", "hazard_type", "severity", "water_depth_est_m", "impact_description", "min_x", "min_y", "max_x", "max_y"], "title": "DetectedHazard", "type": "object"}}, "properties": {"summary": {"title": "Summary", "type": "string"}, "hazards": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/DetectedHazard"}, "title": "Hazards", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["summary", "hazards"], "title": "VisionAnalysisResult", "type": "object"}
